# SARIF schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the unmodified [OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 errata 01 schema](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json), downloaded on 2026-11-14.

SHA-256: `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`.

The tests use this local copy so validation works offline. The validator checks
JSON Schema draft 4 constraints and formats, including artifact URIs.
